findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_schedule, get_stats, create_content_draft, generate_content, update_content, list_media, schedule_content · Private data: request_media_upload · Public sink: get_schedule, get_stats, create_content_draft, supply_entry, generate_content, update_content, request_media_upload, list_media, schedule_content, delete_content · Destructive: create_content_draft, supply_entry, request_media_upload, list_media, delete_content.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_schedule, get_stats, create_content_draft, generate_content, update_content, list_media, schedule_content · Private data: request_media_upload · Public sink: get_schedule, get_stats, create_content_draft, supply_entry, generate_content, update_content, request_media_upload, list_media, schedule_content, delete_content · Destructive: create_content_draft, supply_entry, request_media_upload, list_media, delete_content

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
